name: start
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;A.set('manual', true); await B.idle(1); return B.report("start of play (no intro, seed 2)");})()

name: bail-gautam-in-time
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-38,-26],[-38,-12],[-24,-8],[-10,5],[-10,-30],[-10,-58],[18,-62],[18,-74],[18,-79],[15,-79.4]]); await B.talk('gautam', ['in time'], { at: [15, -80.2] }); await B.watch(3); return { ...B.report("Gautam freed; two hours of forms"), gautamFree: !!G.flags.gautamFree };})()

name: hospital-jeetu
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.sing(); await B.idle(2.5); const sang = A.state().story6a.flags.jeetuCalled; await B.talk('jeetu', ['Come with me'], { at: [-58.2, 89.2] }); return { ...B.report("Jeetu joined"), calledBySong: sang, party: A.state().party };})()

name: hospital-tara-blood
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-55,84],[-55,78],[-41.5,78],[-41.5,84],[-41.5,86]]); const first = A.state().rays; if (first < 5) {                                  /* Tara will not take blood from someone who is shaking: the sun shaft behind the hospital is ten metres away */ await B.go([[-44.5,90],[-45,93],[-45,96]]); await B.healUp(); await B.go([[-45,93],[-44.5,90],[-41.5,86]]); } await B.talk('tara', ['B-positive'], { at: [-41.5, 88.4] }); return { raysOnArrival: first, ...B.report("blood given"), bloodGiven: !!G.flags.bloodGiven };})()

name: depot-sun-heal
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-44.5,90],[-45,93],[-45,96]]); await B.healUp(); return { ...B.report("healed in the depot shaft"), inSun: A.state().world.inSun };})()

name: metro-front-gate
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-45,93],[-45,76],[-45,71.5],[-45,66],[-24,55],[-24,5],[0,5],[39,5],[45,3],[45,-3],[45,-12],[45,-20],[45,-26]]); return { ...B.report("through the Metro gate, no jacket"), gautamDistracting: G.director.gautamDistracting(), guards: A.state().hazards.guards.stats };})()

name: lift-wreck
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[50,-22],[54,-22]]); const at = G.setu.windowId, here = at === 'liftWreck'; if (here) { await B.use('setu'); await B.idle(1); } await B.idle(1); return { ...B.report("at the wrecked lift"), setuWindow: at, foundHere: here, leadMessages: A.state().messages.last.slice(0, 3) };})()

name: aayat-and-setu
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;const w = G.setu.windowId; await B.talk('aayat', [], { at: [-97.5, 15] }); if (!G.setu.found) { await B.use('setu'); await B.idle(1); } return { ...B.report("Aayat and Setu"), setuWindow: w, lead: G.flags.setuLead };})()

name: to-breach-chamber
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-97.5,22],[-105,22],[-117,22],[-117,10],[-117,-10],[-117,-30],[-110,-30]]); return { ...B.report("in the breach chamber"), breachKnown: !!G.flags.breachKnown };})()

name: pump-station-clue
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-110,-28],[-106,-38]]); const ok = await B.read('pumps-chamber'); return { ok, ...B.report("pump station read"), clues: [...G.fragments.clues] };})()

name: ledger-as-jeetu
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-100,-40],[-80,-40],[-79,-45],[-80,-49.5],[-90,-50]]); A.look(-90, 4); B.tap('KeyV'); await B.idle(0.8); await B.sleep(2500); const third = { view: G.view.mode, calls: A.state().render.calls, setuFollowing: G.setu.following, jeetuFollowing: !!G.party.jeetu }; B.tap('KeyV'); await B.idle(0.6); await B.go([[-70,-50]]); await B.tab(); const asJeetu = G.party.active; const ok = await B.read('ledger-boring'); await B.tab(); return { ok, asJeetu, thirdPersonUnderground: third, ...B.report("ledger read as Jeetu"), clues: [...G.fragments.clues] };})()

name: exit-and-heal
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-80,-49.5],[-79,-45],[-79,-40],[-100,-40],[-110,-30],[-125,-28],[-133,-27],[-133,-12],[-133,-3],[-133,3]]); const quay = B.report("west quay"); await B.go([[-110,3],[-75,3],[-75,30],[-60,40],[-52,40]]); await B.healUp(); return { quay, ...B.report("healed under the dead tree"), inSun: A.state().world.inSun };})()

name: tara-warns-the-city
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;await B.go([[-52,43],[-52,60],[-45,66],[-45,71.5],[-45,76],[-41.5,78],[-41.5,84]]); await B.talk('tara', ['Show her the evidence'], { at: [-41.5, 88.4] }); await B.watch(6); return { ...B.report("Tara warns the city"), cityWarned: !!G.flags.cityWarned, via: G.flags.cityWarnedVia };})()

name: bridge-lift

name: reunion-ending-1
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;const t0 = G.time; await B.go([[211,-30]]); await B.watch(150, () => G.endings.current); const e = G.endings.current; return { ending: e && e.type, title: e && e.title, scene: G.cinematics.last, clock: G.clock.hhmm, cityWarned: !!G.flags.cityWarned, setuFound: !!G.flags.setuFound, rays: G.player.rays, minRays: B.minRays, setuHealth: Math.round(G.setu.health), health: A.state().health.stats, detentions: A.state().hazards.detentions, dogBites: G.hazards.dogs.stats.bites, bot: B.stats, stats: A.state().ending };})()
